qualifies_reason: Independent Florence-based publisher with a print volume (Vol. 4, Le Generazioni, 2026) on sale in its own shop, following Vol. 3 (A Tavola) in 2025.
what_it_is: A large-format print annual spun out of an English-language website about Italian travel, food and everyday culture. Each volume takes a single theme (daily life, summer, the table, and most recently the generations) and fills about 124 pages with photo essays by established and younger Italian photographers alongside reported stories and interviews, with two collectible cover variants per volume. It suits readers who follow Italy through its regional food, design and street life rather than through conventional travel guides.
